description: 국토교통부_(TAGO)_버스정류소정보 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토교통부. 정류소명, 정류소번호를 기준으로 시내버스 정류소정보를 조회하는 버스정류소조회 서비스. 제공하는 도시는 [도시코드 목록 조회] 오퍼레이션으로 검색이 가능하다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토교통부. Its tags are 버스정류소, 버스정류장, 정류장정보, 교통물류. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2023-07-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
